title: Sources: the US DOJ will review DoorDash's ~$17B acquisition of Instacart; DoorDash has agreed to pay a $1.25B breakup fee if the deal fails antitrust review (Jody Godoy/Reuters)
summary: Jody Godoy / Reuters: Sources: the US DOJ will review DoorDash's ~$17B acquisition of Instacart; DoorDash has agreed to pay a $1.25B breakup fee if the deal fails antitrust review — The US Department of Justice will review DoorDash's proposed acquisition of Instacart, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.
